plugins.label: footstepsVQL
plugins.description: Footsteps for high-fps players, without the doubled sounds. Stock QL plays fewer footsteps above ~400 fps and none at 500+; footstepsVQL makes such players sound to everyone else like a 250 fps player, and never changes what a player hears from himself.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Off leaves qagame stock. !fsvload / !fsvunload set it too.

cvars.label: Verbose log
cvars.description: Also log the routine per-map lines. Failures are always logged.

cvars.label: Library path
cvars.description: Absolute path to footstepsVQL_hook.so. Empty: next to the plugin, else footstepsVQL_lib/ beside it (where this repository installs it).

commands.name: fsvstatus
commands.description: Version, build, patch state and counters; reset zeroes the counters. Alias !footstepsvql.

commands.name: fsvload
commands.description: Apply the hook now and on future maps.

commands.name: fsvunload
commands.description: Restore stock bytes now and stop re-applying.
